benefit: Nabla scribe cut note time for UCLA physicians in a randomized trial
AI tool: Nabla ambient AI scribe
deployment context: UCLA Health; UCLA Health outpatient clinics, Los Angeles, California, United States
sample: 238 outpatient physicians in 14 specialties at UCLA Health and 23,653 Nabla-arm visits.
use-case relevant outcome: cut their time-in-note by 9.5% against the control group
what the sources leave unknown: The UCLA Health trial's psychometric results on burnout and task load trended favorably but did not reach the threshold for confirmation. Neither Nabla nor DAX Copilot changed physicians' after-hours EHR time.

benefit: TriVerity sorted emergency patients with suspected infection by risk
AI tool: TriVerity
deployment context: Inflammatix (non-interventional SEPSIS-SHIELD study at 22 emergency departments and academic hospitals in the United States and Europe); 22 sites in the United States and Europe
use-case relevant outcome: 80.4% of bacterial results fell in actionable bands
what the sources leave unknown: The study was non-interventional, so results did not guide care. About three in four diagnostic patients came from banked frozen samples. The Very High severity band held only 31 patients. About one in five bacterial results fell in the moderate band, which had a likelihood ratio of 0.9. FDA gives no result on how the test changes treatment or outcomes.

benefit: NICE supports AI help to find fractures on X-rays
developer or vendor: Gleamer (BoneView), Radiobotics (RBfracture), AZmed (Rayvolve) and Milvue (TechCare Alert)
AI tool: AI fracture detection software: BoneView, RBfracture, Rayvolve and TechCare Alert
deployment context: Hospitals in the reader studies reviewed by NICE; NHS urgent care services in England during the evidence generation period; Multiple countries (studies); England, United Kingdom (guidance)
sample: 16 studies, mostly on BoneView (8) and RBfracture (5).
what the sources leave unknown: Most of the 16 studies looked back at past X-rays, and none took place in UK urgent care. Readers typically read X-rays in isolation, without patient history or clinical notes. Unassisted readers were less accurate than expected, so the gain may be overstated. Some studies counted the AI result in the reference standard. There was no evidence on system-level outcomes or on the clinical outcomes of missed fractures.

benefit: Galen Second Read caught prostate cancers missed on a first read
AI tool: Galen Second Read
deployment context: Ibex Medical Analytics (AIDER-2 study at three sites and AIDER-1 reader study with 12 pathologists at four sites); Pathology sites in the United States, with one site outside the US in each study
what the sources leave unknown: Both studies of Galen Second Read used retrospectively collected slides, and the reader study was enriched with challenging tumors. In AIDER-2 only some flagged and unflagged biopsies were verified by experts, so results were adjusted for verification bias. For slides first called benign, the readers' sensitivity with the software was 36.3%. The software is intended for images from one scanner.

benefit: CT scans came six days sooner after Annalise Enterprise CXR arrived
AI tool: Annalise Enterprise CXR
deployment context: NHS Grampian; Grampian, Scotland, United Kingdom
use-case relevant outcome: received a CT scan six days more quickly
what the sources leave unknown: SHTG compared 68 patients after the change with a 2019 baseline of 113, and says it cannot attribute the differences to the AI because other changes came at the same time. It found limited or no published evidence on effectiveness, cost effectiveness or safety. The evaluation did not capture long-term patient outcomes.

benefit: DC-OPGAI-01 helped dentists find more tooth decay on X-rays
developer or vendor: Beijing Yuyi Ganlan Information Technology Co., Ltd. (北京羽医甘蓝信息技术有限公司)
AI tool: DC-OPGAI-01 (龋病口腔曲面体层图像辅助检测软件)
deployment context: Beijing Yuyi Ganlan Information Technology (retrospective reader trial with 12 dentists and 402 subjects at three sites); Three trial sites that the report does not name, for a registration in China
use-case relevant outcome: a tooth-level sensitivity of 82.40%, against 67.43% without it
what the sources leave unknown: The evidence is the maker's own retrospective trial, in which 12 dentists read stored panoramic radiographs of 402 subjects from three sites with and without DC-OPGAI-01. No patient's care depended on the software. CMDE states no reference standard for caries. The software is for trained dentists only and is not a standalone basis for clinical decisions.

benefit: RuiPath shortens pathology review at Ruijin Hospital
AI tool: RuiPath multimodal pathology model
deployment context: Ruijin Hospital; Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai, China
what the sources leave unknown: Huawei describes a reduction from 40 to 15 minutes as a 75% improvement in efficiency, although the cut in elapsed time is 62.5%. It also gives different ranges for different tasks. These measures need defined baselines, and faster review does not mean better diagnosis or treatment.

benefit: IR-CT-PE flagged pulmonary embolism in a two-site trial in China
developer or vendor: Infervision Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (推想医疗科技股份有限公司)
AI tool: IR-CT-PE (肺栓塞CT血管造影图像辅助分诊软件), models IR-CT-PE(A) and IR-CT-PE(B)
deployment context: Infervision Medical Technology (trial with 485 cases at two institutions); Two trial institutions in China that the report does not name
what the sources leave unknown: Infervision's single-arm trial of IR-CT-PE at two institutions compared the software with preset targets of 80% and had no comparison group. An expert panel's reading of the images was the reference. The software's time to a result was compared with the hospitals' time to issue routine reports, which are different measures. The software cannot be the sole basis for decisions.

benefit: Dentbird software designs crowns faster but still needs human review
AI tool: Dentbird Solutions
deployment context: not in the sources
sample: Study 1: 62 patients needing complete crowns on premolars and molars, Korea. Study 2: Five technicians and two crowns each on one master model, Kanagawa Dental University, Japan.
what the sources leave unknown: Imagoworks' claim of design in minutes is not a standardized comparison of total technician time or clinical turnaround. The authors of a clinical study measured crown fit in 62 patients. No rates of repeat work or patient health outcomes have been reported.

benefit: Yizhun-DBU helped less senior readers find breast lesions
developer or vendor: Beijing Yizhun Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (北京医准医疗科技有限公司)
AI tool: Yizhun-DBU (乳腺超声影像辅助检测软件)
deployment context: Beijing Yizhun Medical Technology (prospective reader trial with 176 subjects at three sites); Three trial sites that the report does not name, for a registration in China
use-case relevant outcome: an AFROC-AUC of 0.8785 using Yizhun-DBU, against 0.6500 alone
what the sources leave unknown: The trial was the maker's own, with 176 subjects at three sites and six readers, and the reference was senior readers' judgment rather than pathology. The gain in sensitivity was only borderline, and specificity and false marks per examination did not differ. CMDE says the marks are for reference only and no clinical decision may rest on them alone.

benefit: STAR finds two motile sperm, letting a couple have a girl after 19 years
developer or vendor: Columbia University, Columbia University Irving Medical Center (team led by Zev Williams and Hemant Suryawanshi)
AI tool: STAR (Sperm Tracking and Recovery): a semen sample flows through a single-use microfluidic chip while a high-speed camera (about 300 frames per second, over 8 million images an hour) images it; an AI object-detection model flags sperm among cellular debris in real time and a microfluidic gate or robotic step diverts each flagged sperm into a droplet for immediate injection or freezing
deployment context: Columbia University, New York (used on its own patient); New York, United States
use-case relevant outcome: found seven sperm, two of them motile, in 2.5 million images of a “sperm-free” sample
what the sources leave unknown: The reported pregnancy and birth followed the detection and recovery of sperm and conventional IVF. One successful case is too little to show that the system works in general or that more manual searching would have failed. The often repeated comparison of 44 sperm concerns a different sample, and the later reports of the birth are separate from the original report of the pregnancy.

benefit: ITS-200 helped sonographers spot more malignant thyroid nodules
developer or vendor: Maide Intelligent Technology (Wuxi) Co., Ltd. (脉得智能科技（无锡）有限公司)
AI tool: ITS-200 (甲状腺结节超声影像辅助诊断软件)
deployment context: Maide Intelligent Technology (Wuxi) (prospective randomized trial with 931 subjects at five sites); Five trial sites that the report does not name, for a registration in China
what the sources leave unknown: The maker's trial compared sonographers' readings with surgical pathology and measured accuracy, not patient outcomes. Only the 763 subjects with paraffin pathology entered the main analysis, and 522 of them had malignant nodules. CMDE judged the benefits to outweigh the risks from the applicant's file. The software covers nodules of 5 mm or more that a sonographer outlines by hand.

benefit: After Viz ICH Plus flags a brain bleed, a man is moved in 101 minutes
AI tool: Viz ICH Plus
deployment context: Large urban healthcare system, not named in the report; the city is not stated, and all authors are affiliated with Neurosurgery, Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, New York
what the sources leave unknown: The transfer of 101 minutes is compared with the average of another cohort, with no matched comparison. Surgery and later care also contributed to recovery. One report cannot show that AI caused his functional outcome at one year.

benefit: Abridge scribe eased exhaustion for UW Health clinicians in a trial
AI tool: Abridge ambient AI scribe
deployment context: UW Health (University of Wisconsin Hospitals and Clinics); UW Health ambulatory clinics in Wisconsin and Illinois, United States
sample: 66 practitioners in UW Health ambulatory clinics in Wisconsin and Illinois, with 71,487 notes.
use-case relevant outcome: Time spent on notes fell by 0.36 hours a day
what the sources leave unknown: The UW Health trial's second primary outcome, professional fulfillment, rose by 0.14 points, which the scoping review calls nonsignificant. The review also notes that the size and consistency of ambient scribe effects vary across platforms and outcome measures. The trial's own report could not be read by script, so its stated limitations are not quoted here.

benefit: Brent's child mental health services use AI to cut admin for reports
AI tool: AI used by Brent CAMHS to produce reports (not named in the report)
deployment context: Brent Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS), in the Brent local area partnership; Brent, London, England, United Kingdom
what the sources leave unknown: The inspectors give one sentence on the AI as an example of CAMHS progress on waiting times. They give no figure for administration time saved, do not name the tool, do not say what they saw of its use, and do not separate its effect from the additional clinicians. Waits remained lengthy, and the inspectors asked the partnership to reduce them.

benefit: European endoscopists weakly back CADe in screening colonoscopy
developer or vendor: Medtronic (GI Genius), Fujifilm (CAD EYE), Wision AI (EndoScreener) and other makers
AI tool: Computer-aided detection (CADe) colonoscopy systems in the 44 trials behind ESGE's position, including GI Genius, CAD EYE and EndoScreener
deployment context: Endoscopy services in the 44 randomized trials that the evidence pooled, with screening and surveillance services in Europe as intended users; Multiple countries (trials), with a position for Europe
use-case relevant outcome: 44.7% of patients with CADe against 36.7% without
what the sources leave unknown: ESGE calls its recommendation weak because the evidence is limited, the estimates carry considerable uncertainty, and the absolute benefits for cancer incidence and mortality are small. The BMJ panel found low-certainty evidence of little or no effect on cancer deaths. In the pooled trials, advanced neoplasia found per colonoscopy was similar with and without CADe.

benefit: Facial log-ins cut absences of health staff in Andhra Pradesh
AI tool: Facial recognition attendance system with geo-location for health staff in Andhra Pradesh's public health facilities (not named in the review)
deployment context: Andhra Pradesh Department of Health and Family Welfare (DoHFW); Andhra Pradesh, India
what the sources leave unknown: The World Bank's completion report says that absenteeism fell to a negligible level but gives no figure before or after. It calls the system's cost low relative to the salary savings without giving either amount. The Bank's stated lesson ties lower absenteeism to a zero-vacancy policy supported by digitized attendance, so the facial recognition system's own effect cannot be separated.

benefit: ENAD-DET-01 helps Seoul endoscopists find more adenomas
AI tool: ENAD-DET-01 (ENdoscopy as AI-powered Device)
deployment context: Korea University Medical Center and Ewha Womans University Medical Center; Seoul, South Korea
sample: 998 patients at two tertiary hospitals in Seoul, May 2023 to April 2025.
use-case relevant outcome: found adenomas in 52.3% of patients against 36.1% with standard colonoscopy
what the sources leave unknown: The trial did not measure how many adenomas were missed. The authors say that this may have overstated the system's performance. Nine experienced endoscopists did the procedures, and results may not fully account for operator skill. The endpoints were detection rates, not later cancers. Gains for serrated lesions, cancers and flat lesions were not significant. The system's cost is not yet defined.

benefit: Lesotho's mobile trucks bring AI-assisted TB screening to remote areas
AI tool: Digital chest X-ray with artificial intelligence on mobile TB screening trucks (product not named)
deployment context: Government of Lesotho (Ministry of Health as lead ministry), community-based TB management in three districts under the World Bank-financed regional project; Three districts of Lesotho (not named in the review)
what the sources leave unknown: The World Bank reviewers name no AI product and give no count of people screened on the trucks or of costs averted. The coverage figures come from an evaluation by ECSA-HC, a body the project financed, and cover the whole community package, so the AI's part cannot be separated.

benefit: Jewel patch defibrillator ended eight of nine life-threatening rhythms
AI tool: Jewel Patch Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator (P-WCD) with a machine learning VT/VF detection algorithm
deployment context: Twenty-nine US investigational sites in the Jewel IDE study; Twenty-nine investigational sites, United States
what the sources leave unknown: The study was open-label with no control group, so no comparison with another defibrillator or with no device is possible. Only nine patients received an appropriate shock, and the Jewel's effect on survival rests on those eight conversions, with no outcome after the shocks reported. Patients wore the patch for weeks, not years.

benefit: EchoGo Heart Failure reclassified most cases that scores left open
AI tool: EchoGo Heart Failure
deployment context: Hospitals in the retrospective US and UK studies that ACE reviewed (not yet in use in Singapore); United States and United Kingdom (studies), assessed for Singapore
use-case relevant outcome: reclassified 73.5% of cases left indeterminate by the HFA-PEFF score
what the sources leave unknown: The studies were retrospective, and ACE found no prospective multicenter validation. The published studies lack Asian representation, and performance in ethnic minorities and patients with several conditions is unclear. Most studies were supported by Ultromics grants or had authors employed by the company. The brief rests on a limited literature search without critical appraisal.

benefit: NICE assessors estimate that DERM could halve urgent skin referrals
AI tool: DERM (Deep Ensemble for Recognition of Malignancy)
deployment context: NHS teledermatology services in England, including sites already using DERM; England, United Kingdom
use-case relevant outcome: could about halve urgent referrals to a dermatologist
what the sources leave unknown: The halving is an estimate from an assessment-group analysis of eligible lesions. Neither main study tested equivalence with dermatologists, and one relied on a single dermatologist's diagnosis for lesions without biopsy. Almost no participants had black skin. The effect on dermatology capacity remains unclear.

benefit: Hospital disputes that ChatGPT helped save a teenager from poisoning
AI tool: ChatGPT, according to the patient's cousin. He described the model as an advanced AI model and a limited-use trial version of GPT-5, but that identification is unverified. OpenAI publicly introduced GPT-5 on 7 August 2025, after the May report.
deployment context: The patient's cousin, as a consumer user; Abnoub and Assiut University Hospital, Assiut Governorate, Egypt
what the sources leave unknown: The dean's direct account contradicts the reported poisoning. Neither the inspector nor the hospital has produced a complete conversation or a clinical record that would show a recovery caused by the AI. The inspector's claimed trial access to GPT-5 is undocumented and predates the model's public release on 7 August 2025. The date of ingestion is unknown.

benefit: Allix5 read five-year breast cancer risk from a mammogram
AI tool: Allix5
deployment context: Clairity (retrospective study on mammograms from five US screening sites); Atlanta, Georgia; Fort Worth and Bedford, Texas; Sacramento and Folsom, California, United States
sample: 77,511 exams from 44,112 patients at five US screening sites not used for training.
use-case relevant outcome: an AUC of 0.70, above a goal of 0.64
what the sources leave unknown: The pivotal study was retrospective, and no site used the scores in care. It compared the software with a fixed goal drawn from traditional risk models, not with those models on the same patients. Effectiveness was not shown for women with breast implants. Calibration was not shown for Asian women, women under 50 or over 65, or women with implants.

benefit: Ghanaian researchers propose smartphone AI to detect malaria parasites
developer or vendor: CSIR Institute for Scientific and Technological Information (CSIR-INSTI) and Bolgatanga Technical University
AI tool: Smartphone-over-microscope TinyML malaria detection
deployment context: not in the sources
what the sources leave unknown: The Lacuna challenge is a testbed, and it is no evidence of clinical deployment. No model accuracy, robustness to slide quality, field validation, change in health workers' decisions or treatment outcome has been reported. Planned data collection in clinics cannot establish a present benefit.

benefit: Tata Elxsi plans AI to monitor patients in remote areas
AI tool: Tata Elxsi smart remote-healthcare MVP
deployment context: not in the sources
what the sources leave unknown: Testing under control or in shadow mode cannot show better access or earlier treatment for rural patients. Tata Elxsi gives no count of enrolled patients, no validated triage performance, no completed intervention and no health outcome. Clinical validation and regulatory work remain future steps.

benefit: Northern Territory team plans AI to guide services for ear disease
AI tool: NT Health geospatial otitis-media mapping
deployment context: NT Hearing Services; Northern Territory, Australia
what the sources leave unknown: No source shows that the AI analysis was run. On 25 May 2026 the team was still selecting AI tools for modeling. Mapping and data linkage alone do not establish an AI contribution. No decision about where to direct services, improvement in care or comparison with conventional mapping has been reported.

benefit: MEDIAIPLUS reports faster clinical-trial preparation with its AI tools
AI tool: MediC and FiCRO
deployment context: Pilot partners including Blisstech; South Korea (pilots)
what the sources leave unknown: MEDIAIPLUS reports that its tools cut the time for data alignment by 85% and outsourcing costs by 10% and raised trial success by 25%. The company gives no trial counts or comparison periods for these figures and does not describe how they were measured. Its savings figures vary across its statements. No faster patient access to therapy has been measured.

benefit: A university is developing a moral-tale game for autistic children
AI tool: MoralQuest
deployment context: not in the sources
what the sources leave unknown: The minimum viable product is still in development, with dataset collection and stronger models planned. The academic skills, emotional support and inclusion that the team names are intended effects, with no group of children evaluated. Difficulty that adjusts by rules is no tested learned intervention.

benefit: A university plans software that corrects rehabilitation exercises
AI tool: AI-driven exercise assessment and live-feedback system
deployment context: not in the sources
what the sources leave unknown: A planned evaluation cannot show that the feedback is accurate or that it improves recovery beyond usual rehabilitation. Safety, adherence and performance in unsupervised homes remain untested.

benefit: A Nigerian team plans software to make impaired speech clearer
AI tool: AI4Africa AI-powered AAC tool
deployment context: Nigeria
what the sources leave unknown: The team names Limi Hospital as one of the hospitals that it plans to approach to test the tool. The hospital was not a confirmed testbed. The team has not reported that any person with a speech disability used the tool. Gains in speech intelligibility and communication accuracy require completed development and an evaluation with participants.

benefit: A Tanzanian university plans wearable alerts for abnormal vital signs
developer or vendor: Mbeya University of Science and Technology
AI tool: AI-Based Health Monitoring and Advisory System
deployment context: not in the sources
what the sources leave unknown: The team names no pilot, and fewer complications of disease are described as an expected impact. The team gives no detection performance, alert acted on, clinical outcome or comparison of access. Planned biosensors and deeper models further limit what can be said about the present system.

benefit: EquiDermAI is meant to reduce gaps between skin tones in AI diagnosis
AI tool: EquiDermAI
deployment context: not in the sources
what the sources leave unknown: Data augmentation and on-device design do not establish reduced diagnostic disparities. Performance across skin tones, clinical validation and measured effects on access and energy use are still needed.

benefit: A journaling tool in development would give students emotional feedback
AI tool: StudentSphere AI journaling system
deployment context: not in the sources
what the sources leave unknown: In its summary, the team says that an internal pilot is planned, while in its description it calls the product actively deployed. Clinical validation and oversight by psychiatrists remain future work. The figures for accuracy in classifying emotions and for response time are targets, and no completed crisis response or measured fall in stress has been reported.

benefit: Researchers plan hospital tests of a wheelchair steered by brain waves
AI tool: Brain-wave driven wheelchair for paralysis patients using EEG and ML
deployment context: not in the sources
what the sources leave unknown: Training data from ten people do not establish independent control by people with paralysis. The researchers give no participant characteristics, held-out testing, command errors, safety failures, control comparators or sustained mobility outcomes.

benefit: A planned smartwatch system would monitor facial paralysis
AI tool: Smart Watch based Integration System for Habituating Face Paralysis Monitoring
deployment context: not in the sources
what the sources leave unknown: The team labels deployment active while it places mimicry-recognition models, their training data and a suitable watch in future work. No patient result resolves that discrepancy, and earlier intervention and better quality of life are prospective claims.

benefit: AI for organoid research is meant to speed up drug screening
AI tool: AI-Enhanced Organoid Platform for Pandemic Preparedness and Personalized Medicine
deployment context: Hong Kong and Shanghai (partner testing)
what the sources leave unknown: Latency and satisfaction are different from outcomes in drug discovery or for patients. The claimed 50% improvement in screening has no comparison from this project, and pandemic preparedness has not been measured.

benefit: A hearing aid's noise filter helps implant users follow speech in noise
AI tool: Phonak Audéo Sphere Infinio 90 hearing aid with DNN-based noise reduction (Spheric Speech in Loud Noise program)
deployment context: Mayo Clinic audiology clinics (Scottsdale, Arizona, and Rochester, Minnesota); Mayo Clinic, Scottsdale, Arizona, and Rochester, Minnesota, United States
sample: 11 bimodal cochlear implant users aged 71 to 89, Mayo Clinic.
use-case relevant outcome: bimodal sentence scores on the AzBio test reached 79% with the DNN program against 60%
what the sources leave unknown: The study reviews the charts of 11 patients aged 71 to 89, tested between 6 May and 1 June 2025, with no long-term follow-up. Speech and babble came from one loudspeaker in front, and the comparison program used no noise reduction. Some patients scored near the ceiling. One author receives research support and consulting fees from cochlear implant makers.

benefit: Six AI chest X-ray readers meet WHO's standard for TB screening
developer or vendor: Delft Imaging (CAD4TB), VinBrain (DrAid), DeepTek (Genki Edge), Infervision (InferRead DR Chest), Lunit (Insight CXR) and Qure.ai (qXR)
AI tool: CAD4TB, DrAid for TB screening, Genki Edge, InferRead DR Chest, Insight CXR and qXR (computer-aided detection software for TB)
deployment context: FIND's independent validation platform in Geneva, for WHO (archived chest X-ray libraries); Global (evaluation in Geneva, Switzerland)

WHO says that limited data prevented review of accuracy in subgroups such as people living with HIV, women and people with earlier TB. The statement covers people aged 15 and older, and it did not consider costs or support structure because manufacturers gave little data.

benefit: uAI-CT_CerebralPerfusion agreed with a marketed tool on stroke scans
developer or vendor: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd. (上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司)
AI tool: uAI-CT_CerebralPerfusion (脑缺血CT灌注图像辅助评估软件)
deployment context: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence (retrospective registration trial with 446 cases at six institutions); Six trial institutions that the report does not name, for a registration in China

It measured agreement with another marketed software product, not accuracy against a clinical reference or patient outcomes. Agreement was weaker for the penumbra, where the regression R² was 0.50 against 0.86 for the infarct core.

benefit: DeepSeek-R1 flags familial Mediterranean fever, which gene tests confirm
AI tool: DeepSeek-R1
deployment context: Hamburg, Germany
use-case relevant outcome: colchicine stopped attacks after about 30 years of symptoms
what the sources leave unknown: One case cannot show how accurate or safe the chatbot is for people without supervision. Genetic confirmation and clinician review were necessary, and self-medication was followed by raised liver enzymes. The authors of the 2025 study found that three other chatbots gave their weakest answers on the diagnosis of familial Mediterranean fever. That finding limits how far one correct chatbot diagnosis can be generalized.

benefit: ChatGPT links a Reddit user's years of symptoms to a gene result
AI tool: ChatGPT (OpenAI consumer app), given five uploaded Function Health lab PDFs and a written symptom timeline
deployment context: OpenAI; United States
what the sources leave unknown: The genetic variant was already in the user's test results. The sources do not show that it caused the symptoms, that B vitamins caused the improvement or that a doctor confirmed the reading. Despite the published criticism and the deleted post, the sources contain no report that the recovery was reversed.

benefit: Face2Gene's DeepGestalt changes geneticists' testing in 17 cases
AI tool: Face2Gene (DeepGestalt facial phenotyping)
deployment context: Clinical genetics services at the authors' institutions in the United States, Georgia, Italy and Canada (per Crossref affiliations); United States, Georgia, Italy and Canada (authors' institutions)
what the sources leave unknown: Cases were selected retrospectively because clinicians recalled a changed decision, so the series cannot estimate general diagnostic accuracy, error rates or savings in time and cost. One co-author was affiliated with FDNA. No follow-up on the 19 patients has been reported.

benefit: Nephew uses ChatGPT to sum up research while a relative has chemotherapy
AI tool: ChatGPT (an earlier model, later GPT-5)
deployment context: The patient's nephew (Uzman Dent, Baku) with the patient; Baku, Azerbaijan (surgery and pathology performed in Turkey)
what the sources leave unknown: The patient received FOLFIRINOX alongside off-label adjuncts, so the regression cannot be credited to ChatGPT or the adjuncts. The benefit that the author, a family member, reports is help with finding and weighing information. The disappearance of the lesions on imaging does not show a cure through AI or that the off-label regimen works.

benefit: ChatGPT ties a mother's 18-month cough to her blood pressure drug
AI tool: ChatGPT
deployment context: OpenAI
what the sources leave unknown: The change of medication and the improvement rest on the daughter's account, which names no drug and comes with no clinical record or statement from a treating clinician. The warning that the condition could be fatal within six months is also unverified. An improvement after a change of prescription cannot settle whether ChatGPT saved a life.

benefit: NICE allows the Wysa referral chatbot in NHS talking therapies
AI tool: Wysa Digital Referral Assistant (Wysa DRA)
deployment context: NHS Talking Therapies for anxiety and depression services in England; England, United Kingdom
what the sources leave unknown: NICE's committee had only company-reported, non-comparative data for the Wysa chatbot, none from published research. It could not pool the evidence because of its heterogeneity. It found that evidence on time saved was limited and that the net time saved remains uncertain. It found the evidence's generalisability across NHS Talking Therapies services unclear and the impact on clinical decision making unclear.

benefit: ArteraAI Prostate sorted prostate cancer patients by risk of spread
AI tool: ArteraAI Prostate
deployment context: Artera (clinical validation at three US sites); Three sites, United States
use-case relevant outcome: 10-year metastasis risk was 28.1% in its high risk category
what the sources leave unknown: The FDA review reports how well the categories separated 10-year risk in 886 patients. It does not show that treatment guided by the software changed outcomes, and FDA says only that the device may help reduce under- or over-treatment. Only 72 patients were African American. The submission held no information on patient perspectives.

benefit: After a scan aided by Brainomix finds a stroke, she leaves in 25 minutes
AI tool: Brainomix 360 Stroke
deployment context: NHS England / Royal Berkshire Hospital; Reading, United Kingdom
sample: 109 patients transferred for thrombectomy from five low-volume primary stroke centers in Poland over 53 months, and 69 patients at a comprehensive stroke center.
use-case relevant outcome: transferred in 25 minutes for successful thrombectomy
what the sources leave unknown: A transfer within 25 minutes and a good individual recovery do not isolate the contribution of Brainomix 360 Stroke. The 64-minute reduction that NHS England reports comes from a different comparison and does not measure the time saved for this patient. NICE stated in January 2024 that it is unclear how much of the faster access to treatment comes from the software.

benefit: ChatGPT lists a rare condition that a genetic test confirms
AI tool: ChatGPT
deployment context: Cardiff, United Kingdom
what the sources leave unknown: The evidence is the patient's account through two outlets. The reporters do not say that they inspected clinical records, the prompt, the model version or the full list of candidates. Diagnosis alone does not establish a treatment benefit, and reports of how long the coma lasted disagree.

benefit: ChatGPT flags an insulinoma that doctors missed, which surgery removes
AI tool: ChatGPT
deployment context: Majadahonda, Spain
use-case relevant outcome: surgeons removed about two thirds of his pancreas and his symptoms went
what the sources leave unknown: Every report traces to the account of the patient or his partner, and none gives pathology results or testimony from a clinician who treated him. The only physician quoted, David Céspedes, had no part in his care. Some headlines spoke of pancreatic cancer, but an insulinoma is not by itself evidence of a malignant cancer.

benefit: Staff agree with ChatGPT that a worsening spider bite is an emergency
AI tool: ChatGPT
deployment context: Wolfforth, United States
what the sources leave unknown: No confirmed diagnosis, treatment or follow-up is reported, and the clinicians' comments come only through the woman's account. This case does not show whether ChatGPT saved her life or whether its advice on where to seek care is accurate in general.

benefit: GPT-5 lists oncocytoma first in two retrospective cases
AI tool: ChatGPT (GPT-5, 2025 version)
deployment context: Department of Medicine, Surgery and Pharmacy, University of Sassari; Sassari, Italy
sample: Two patients with caruncular oncocytoma confirmed by histology at the University of Sassari eye clinic, plus three published images of other caruncular tumors.
what the sources leave unknown: The original two diagnoses were known before testing. Additional tumor tests expose misclassification, but the small selected sample does not establish sensitivity or specificity. Queries were not repeated, and the study did not compare independent clinician assessments or measure prospective patient benefit.

benefit: MIAS-3000 flagged macular degeneration on OCT scans in China's review
developer or vendor: Suzhou Bigvision Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (苏州比格威医疗科技有限公司)
AI tool: MIAS-3000 (眼科OCT图像辅助诊断软件)
deployment context: Suzhou Bigvision Medical Technology (prospective multicenter registration trial with 908 subjects); Trial sites in China that the report does not name
what the sources leave unknown: The trial was the maker's own, a prospective multicenter single-group study of 908 subjects in which doctors read with the software in one group and alone in the other. CMDE reports sensitivity and specificity per eye and says that clinical decisions must not rest on the product's result alone. No change in any patient's care is reported.

benefit: AI tools find spinal fractures missed in routine scan reports
developer or vendor: Aidoc Medical (BriefCase-Triage), Avicenna.AI (CINA-VCF Quantix), Nanox AI (HealthVCF and HealthOST) and IB Lab (IB Lab FLAMINGO)
AI tool: AI tools for opportunistic detection of vertebral fragility fractures on CT: BriefCase-Triage, CINA-VCF Quantix, HealthVCF, HealthOST and IB Lab FLAMINGO

what the sources leave unknown: Most studies of the AI tools were retrospective and measured diagnostic accuracy, and most comparisons with standard care were done outside the UK. NICE says that it is uncertain how much the tools improve detection in the NHS. Very little evidence shows how they affect clinical management. The model's standard-care values came from a small expert elicitation study.

benefit: AI-Rad Companion Prostate MR lifted readers' accuracy slightly
developer or vendor: Siemens Healthineers, with 上海西门子医疗器械有限公司 (Siemens Shanghai Medical Equipment Ltd.) as the applicant in China
AI tool: AI-Rad Companion Prostate MR (前列腺癌磁共振图像辅助检测软件)

use-case relevant outcome: an AUROC of 0.7010, against 0.6758 without it
what the sources leave unknown: The trial was retrospective, with 12 doctors reading images from 340 subjects. Siemens Shanghai, the applicant, supplied the trial data. The AUROC gain of 0.0252 had a 95% confidence interval from 0.0011 to 0.0493. The sensitivity gain of 4.4% had an interval from -0.2% to 9.1%. Median reading time was 98 seconds in both groups.

benefit: HB-AI-T1 met its targets for triage of breast images in China's review
developer or vendor: Wuhan Haobo Technology Co., Ltd. (武汉昊博科技有限公司)
AI tool: HB-AI-T1 (乳腺热层析影像辅助分诊软件)
deployment context: Wuhan Haobo Technology (registration trial with 743 women at three clinical institutions); Three clinical institutions in China that the report does not name
what the sources leave unknown: The HB-AI-T1 trial was the maker's own single-arm study against target values at three institutions, with no comparison group. Its reference standard was the opinion of a panel of senior sonographers, not pathology. CMDE gives neither the targets nor the sensitivity and specificity reached. The software is not for women with fever or who are breastfeeding, and no outcome of care is reported.

benefit: The tumor halves after an owner designs his dog's cancer vaccine with AI
AI tool: ChatGPT (OpenAI) and AlphaFold (Google DeepMind), used with Conyngham's own analysis to select tumor neoantigen targets for a personalized mRNA vaccine
deployment context: Paul Conyngham (owner), with UNSW's Ramaciotti Centre for Genomics (sequencing), the UNSW RNA Institute (vaccine manufacture) and the University of Queensland School of Veterinary Science, Gatton (administration); Sydney, Australia
use-case relevant outcome: halved Rosie's largest tumor by early 2026
what the sources leave unknown: The vaccine was given with a checkpoint inhibitor, so the tumor shrinkage cannot be credited separately to the vaccine or to the AI-assisted choice of targets. Some tumors did not respond. The cancer returned after a later surgery, and the date of Rosie's death has not been reported. One case is not enough to claim a cure or show that the approach works in general.

benefit: ECG-AI LEF and ELEFT flag weak heart pumps with moderate accuracy

AI tool: Anumana ECG-AI LEF 12-Lead algorithm and Eko Low Ejection Fraction Tool (ELEFT)

The accuracy figures rest on echocardiography as reference, with non-systematic echocardiography in control groups and inter-operator variability. Asian patients made up 0% to 19.9% of the study populations, which may limit generalizability to Singapore.

benefit: A scan confirms the appendicitis that Grok flagged in a man sent home

deployment context: xAI (Grok web app); Norway
what the sources leave unknown: The story after the operation is self-reported, and Grok drafted the Reddit post. The post and the later comments differ on where the first visit was and on how he got back. In August 2026 he wrote that his appendix had ruptured, and in December 2025 he had written that it was about to rupture. No clinician or hospital has confirmed the CT findings or the surgery, and no record is public.

benefit: CA-GPT matches expert stent choices more often than junior physicians
developer or vendor: Tangdu Hospital, Air Force Medical University (Li Yan's team) with Shenzhen Tsinghua University Research Institute (Zhu Rui's team), on a Vivolight Medtech OCT platform
AI tool: CA-GPT large model on an AI-OCT system (COMPARE study)

use-case relevant outcome: stent diameter (90.3% vs. 72.2%, P<0.05) and length selection (80.6% vs. 52.8%, P<0.01)
what the sources leave unknown: The comparison combines differences in models, retrieval and input processing, because CA-GPT received raw OCT images while ChatGPT-5 received manually extracted measurements. Nothing in the study shows improved clinical outcomes. The authors of the preprint and Machine Heart describe the retrieval sources differently.

benefit: AI-based image analysis detects referable diabetic retinopathy
developer or vendor: Several vendors, among them Eyenuk (EyeArt), Digital Diagnostics (IDx-DR) and EyRIS (SELENA)
AI tool: AI-based image analysis of fundus photographs for diabetic retinopathy screening (products in the included studies such as EyeArt, IDx-DR, SELENA, RetCAD and Aireen)

HTA syd could not judge whether recalls, future vision loss or blindness change with AI grading. Sweden's grading scale differs from the international standard, which makes the results hard to transfer. Moderate certainty means that more research is needed, and no current cost-effectiveness analysis exists.

benefit: An Apple Watch called for help after a runner’s heart stopped

use-case relevant outcome: began cardiopulmonary resuscitation about 6–7 minutes after the collapse
what the sources leave unknown: The authors give no date or place. The identification of the patient, the date and the street are inferred from interviews and a pager message. Men's Health says that the runner also pressed the SOS button himself and that a pulse returned within about three minutes. This account does not fit the timeline in the paper. The case cannot show how quickly he would have been found without the alert.

benefit: Clinicians feel less burdened by documentation with AI scribes
developer or vendor: Several makers, including Nuance (Dragon Ambient eXperience), Abridge, Nabla, Sunoh.ai and Amazon

benefit: A phone camera coach improved blood pressure in hypertension
AI tool: Rehabilitation Exercise Prescription app (AI pose recognition built on TensorFlow and OpenPose)
deployment context: Zhujiang Hospital, Southern Medical University, and Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital; Guangzhou, Guangdong, China
sample: 62 adults aged 18 to 75 with hypertension, Guangzhou.
use-case relevant outcome: The app group gained 62.77 meters more in the 6-minute walk test than the control group
what the sources leave unknown: The trial enrolled 62 patients by convenience sampling at two Guangzhou hospitals, was open-label and lasted eight weeks. The authors say that the small sample from one region limits generalizability and that eight weeks cannot show long-term effects.

benefit: Ward staff revive a patient after thynC flags a pre-arrest heart rhythm
developer or vendor: Seers Technology Co., Seongnam (maker of the ThynC patch); Daewoong Pharmaceutical supplies thynC
AI tool: thynC (씽크) AI-based smart bed monitoring system: wearable sensors measuring ECG, heart rate and respiratory rate in real time, with alarms sent to a remote central monitor
deployment context: Gwangju Hanguk Hospital (광주한국병원); Gwangju, South Korea
use-case relevant outcome: heart rate climbed to 192 beats per minute
what the sources leave unknown: The account comes through the supplier, with no clinical record and no response time that anyone independent has assessed. Staff resuscitated the patient, and the time that would have passed without the alert is unknown. A restored circulation leaves long-term recovery unknown.

benefit: Mother's AI query prompts a rare-disease diagnosis in a 22-month-old
AI tool: Smartphone application described by the authors as powered by Med-Gemini-3D
deployment context: The patient's mother (consumer use); United States (authors at Garnet Health Medical Center, Middletown, New York)
what the sources leave unknown: In their abstract, the authors do not identify the app or show that it ran Med-Gemini-3D. They do not say which therapeutic interventions followed or what they achieved.

benefit: PhenoMATRIX sorted images of culture plates with few missed growths
AI tool: PhenoMATRIX
deployment context: Three US clinical microbiology laboratories in the clinical study; Three clinical laboratories, United States
what the sources leave unknown: PhenoMATRIX results on plate images were compared with experienced technicians reviewing the same digital images, not with patient outcomes or a separate culture reading. The study ran at three US laboratories. Agreement was lower for some tasks, such as 91.8% for growth purity at Site A and 90.1% for growth semi-quantification on CHROMagar Orientation at Site C. A trained microbiologist still reviews every image.

benefit: EA PC-UGI helped readers spot more stomach lesions in a trial
developer or vendor: Wuhan EndoAngel Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (武汉楚精灵医疗科技有限公司)
AI tool: EA PC-UGI (胃部病变电子内窥镜图像辅助分诊软件)
deployment context: Wuhan EndoAngel Medical Technology (retrospective reader trial with 340 cases at four sites); Four trial sites in China that the report does not name
use-case relevant outcome: a lesion-level sensitivity of 85.80% for gastric lesions, against 79.94% alone
what the sources leave unknown: EndoAngel's trial of EA PC-UGI was retrospective, with readers reviewing stored images against pathology, so it measured no effect on patient care. It had a sample size of 340 at four centers, and the sensitivity gain had a wide interval of 1.72% to 9.99%. The software works only with specified endoscopes and imaging modes and cannot be the sole basis for decisions.

benefit: Lunit INSIGHT CXR flags a subpulmonic effusion that ultrasound confirms
AI tool: Lunit INSIGHT CXR
deployment context: Basic Emergency Service, Vila Real de Santo Antonio Health Center, Algarve Local Health Unit; Vila Real de Santo Antonio, Algarve, Portugal
what the sources leave unknown: Correct identification does not establish subsequent clinical improvement. The patient's refusal limits the observed outcome, and the retained case does not isolate what the radiographer would have recognized without the AI output.

benefit: uAI-BreastTomoCare helped doctors find more breast masses
developer or vendor: United Imaging Intelligence (Beijing) Co., Ltd. (联影智能医疗科技（北京）有限公司)
AI tool: uAI-BreastTomoCare (乳腺X射线断层图像辅助检测软件)
deployment context: United Imaging Intelligence (Beijing) (retrospective reader trial on images of 432 subjects from three centers); Three trial centers that the report does not name, for a registration in China
use-case relevant outcome: 62.17% of breast mass lesions on tomosynthesis, against 50.42% without it
what the sources leave unknown: The trial was the maker's own retrospective reading study of stored images from three centers. It measured mass detection, not outcomes for patients. Used alone, the software had a specificity of 53.81% at the patient level. The review says that trained doctors must use it and that it cannot serve alone as the basis for clinical decisions.

benefit: Claire OCT System helped surgeons remove cancer left at the margins
AI tool: Claire OCT System with the ImgAssist AI detection algorithm
deployment context: Breast surgeons at the investigational sites of the randomized trial (NCT05113927); Investigational sites, United States
what the sources leave unknown: The Claire OCT System was used only after surgeons finished standard margin assessment, so its gain is measured as an add-on in 206 device-arm patients, with 7 patients converted to clear margins. FDA notes that real-world use may differ from trial conditions. Margin-level sensitivity and specificity were assessed post hoc, and no outcome such as recurrence is reported.

benefit: Tyto Insights detects bulging eardrums better than non-ENT doctors
AI tool: Tyto Insights for Eardrum Bulging Detection
deployment context: Tyto Care (retrospective validation on 857 otoscope recordings from real-world use); Recording sites not stated in the decision summary
what the sources leave unknown: not checked

benefit: England's health technology assessor supports AI help in colonoscopy
developer or vendor: Odin Vision (CADDIE), Fujifilm (CAD EYE), Olympus Medical Systems (ENDO-AID), Wision AI (EndoScreener), Medtronic (GI Genius) and Magentiq Eye (MAGENTIQ-COLO)
AI tool: AI computer-aided detection (CADe) for colonoscopy: CADDIE, CAD EYE, ENDO-AID, EndoScreener, GI Genius and MAGENTIQ-COLO
deployment context: Endoscopy services in the trials reviewed by NICE; NHS services in England during the evidence generation period; Multiple countries (trials); England, United Kingdom (guidance)
sample: 70 studies of AI-assisted live colonoscopy, mostly randomized controlled trials.
what the sources leave unknown: NICE's committee judged it uncertain whether the higher adenoma detection rate will lower colorectal cancer rates. Gains for advanced adenomas and sessile serrated lesions were not statistically significant for any system. Most studies excluded people with Lynch syndrome, familial adenomatous polyposis or inflammatory bowel disease. Data on false positives were very limited. The quality and quantity of evidence varied across systems.

benefit: ArtiQ.Spiro raised sensitivity for COPD in a UK trial
AI tool: ArtiQ.Spiro
deployment context: SPIRO-AID trial with 133 UK primary care professionals reviewing past spirometry records; United Kingdom
what the sources leave unknown: In SPIRO-AID, professionals reviewed 50 past spirometry tests, a small sample with few normal results. The external group calculated accuracy from data that the authors supplied in confidence. Accuracy in primary care use is unclear, and no study reported long-term outcomes.

benefit: A mental health chatbot eased low mood in tinnitus
AI tool: Woebot
deployment context: Leeds Trinity University School of Social Sciences (trial); United Kingdom (online trial recruited with Tinnitus UK)
sample: 105 UK adults with self-reported persistent tinnitus, three arms of 36 with three withdrawals.
use-case relevant outcome: Woebot users lowered depression scores on the PHQ-9 from 10.03 to 8.06
what the sources leave unknown: All outcomes were self-reported, and tinnitus diagnoses were self-reported without clinical assessment. Follow-up lasted only the eight-week intervention. Participants could not be blinded, so a placebo effect is possible. The trial was not prospectively registered, and adherence data were not systematically collected.

benefit: Skåne backs AI fundus grading to free hours in diabetic eye screening
developer or vendor: Retmarker (DAIRET), Aireen and other makers, with an in-house model in one study
AI tool: AI-developed automated image analysis of fundus photographs, including DAIRET (Retmarker) and Aireen in the studies behind the main finding
deployment context: Screening services in the studies that HTA South reviewed, with prospective use at Region Skåne's eye clinics; Multiple countries (studies), with a recommendation for Skåne, Sweden
what the sources leave unknown: The council's precision finding rests on four studies rated low in certainty. The studies were too short to show effects on vision loss or blindness. The 1,400 hours are a calculated example, not an observed saving. The council had no basis to judge cost-effectiveness, and HTA South notes that no such software was yet in use in Swedish screening programs.

benefit: AI-estimated CT-FFR agrees well with invasive heart tests, SHTG finds
developer or vendor: Siemens Healthineers (cFFR), Keya Medical (DEEPVESSEL-FFR) and other makers
AI tool: Machine-learning CT-FFR software in the meta-analyses that SHTG reviewed: cFFR, DEEPVESSEL-FFR, skCT-FFR and XFFR
deployment context: Study sites in the meta-analyses that SHTG reviewed, with NHSScotland cardiology services as prospective users; Multiple countries (studies), with an overview for Scotland, United Kingdom
use-case relevant outcome: pooled sensitivity of 0.86 and specificity of 0.87
what the sources leave unknown: SHTG's finding rests on meta-analyzes of mostly retrospective studies that defined AI and FFR thresholds differently, with high heterogeneity and concerns about bias. The outcome is agreement with invasive FFR, not what happened to patients. No study tested whether CT-FFR adds value to CT angiography alone, and no study reported later tests, outcomes, patient experience or costs.

benefit: ArteraAI Breast sorted patients with breast cancer by risk of spread
AI tool: ArteraAI Breast
deployment context: Artera (retrospective clinical validation on archived slides from 1,271 patients at three US sites); Three sites, United States
use-case relevant outcome: five-year distant metastasis risk was 8.7% in its high risk group
what the sources leave unknown: The validation was retrospective, in 1,271 patients at three US sites, and no patient's care depended on ArteraAI Breast. Risk separation differed by race: in the high risk group, African American patients had a lower observed five-year risk than White patients, 6.4% against 9.7%, and the smallest racial subgroups had no events in the low risk group.

benefit: uAI MI Onco flagged chest uptake on PET/CT scans in China's review
developer or vendor: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd. (上海联影智能医疗科技有限公司)
AI tool: uAI MI Onco (胸部核医学图像辅助分诊软件)
deployment context: Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence (retrospective registration trial with 596 cases at two sites); Two trial sites that the report does not name, for a registration in China
what the sources leave unknown: The trial was retrospective and used stored images from two sites. An expert panel's reading was the reference. The enrollment plan fixed 248 positive and 348 negative patients. The report gives no patient outcomes.

benefit: AI Local AutoVision cut time to analyze karyotypes in China's review
developer or vendor: Hangzhou Diagens Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (杭州德适生物科技股份有限公司)
AI tool: AI Local AutoVision (染色体核型图像辅助诊断软件)
deployment context: Hangzhou Diagens Biotechnology (registration trial with 1,734 subjects at three hospitals); First People's Hospital of Yunnan Province, Third Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University and Reproductive Hospital Affiliated to Shandong University, China
use-case relevant outcome: 11.19 minutes on average per karyotype, against 34.42 minutes by hand
what the sources leave unknown: The trial was Hangzhou Diagens's own, at three hospitals. The reference standard was an expert panel reading the same images, so accuracy and time were measured against other readers, not against patient outcomes. The CMDE report gives no result from laboratories using the registered product and does not show that the software's results guided any patient's care.

benefit: Apple Watch breathing alerts send a 79-year-old to CPAP therapy
AI tool: Apple Watch Sleep Apnea Notification Feature (breathing-disturbance notifications) and the ECG app
deployment context: Fukuoka, Japan
what the sources leave unknown: No polysomnography was performed, so sleep apnea is unconfirmed. The consultation is undated, and the authors do not state what the ECG app's classifier reported. No effect of CPAP on the paroxysms is reported.

benefit: Wearable rhythm strips let a 59-year-old go straight to ablation
developer or vendor: Not stated (the report does not name the device's maker)
AI tool: Consumer wearable device with smartphone-linked rhythm-strip recording (brand and model not stated)
deployment context: Newport News, Virginia, United States (corresponding author's clinic; the case text does not name the clinic)
what the sources leave unknown: The authors name neither the device's brand nor its maker, and they do not say whether its own algorithm classified any episode. The event dates are not given, and the follow-up is undated.

benefit: DeepCxR would cut TB screening costs at some loss of accuracy
developer or vendor: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Department of Health Research (DHR) and Institute for Plasma Research (IPR), Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India
AI tool: DeepCxR (AI-assisted chest X-ray interpretation for TB screening)
deployment context: India's National TB Elimination Program (NTEP), as the program that HTAIn modeled (no deployment described); India
what the sources leave unknown: The saving is modeled for 1,000 adults with presumptive TB, not measured in a screening program. The brief does not name the study behind DeepCxR's sensitivity and specificity. It gives only the totals of the modeled costs, without their inputs.

benefit: G-STRIDE spots more older people at risk of falls than the TUG test
developer or vendor: Academic consortium of Universidad Rey Juan Carlos and collaborators
AI tool: G-STRIDE (shoe-mounted inertial sensor with a machine-learning gait algorithm)
deployment context: The Spanish validation study that SESCS used, with 157 people over 70; Spain
what the sources leave unknown: The gain over the Timed Up and Go test comes from one Spanish study of 157 people over 70 that classified them by past falls. SESCS found 16 studies in all but rated the evidence very low in certainty, and none measured falls prevented. It found no economic evaluation of G-STRIDE that met its criteria.

benefit: GluRing estimated blood glucose without a needle in China's review
developer or vendor: Beijing Lepu Diagnostics Technology Co., Ltd. (北京乐普诊断科技股份有限公司)
AI tool: GluRing and GluRing s non-invasive glucose meter (无创血糖仪)
deployment context: Beijing Lepu Diagnostics Technology (registration trial with 96 subjects at three clinical institutions); Three clinical institutions in China that the report does not name
use-case relevant outcome: differed from venous values by 9.20% on average
what the sources leave unknown: Lepu, the applicant, ran the trial, which enrolled 96 subjects at three institutions and compared GluRing readings with venous glucose. Error grew over the wearing period, from a MARD of 7.22 percent on day one to 10.40 percent at about day 30. The ring needs finger-stick calibration at least every 30 days, and its estimates may not guide decisions on medication.

benefit: A smartwatch detects a father's atrial fibrillation before heart surgery
AI tool: Samsung Health Monitor ECG Monitor app
deployment context: Not stated in the read reports
use-case relevant outcome: About ten days later he returned for open-heart surgery
what the sources leave unknown: No clinical record has been published, and the date and place of the event are not given. The installed app, operating-system and classifier versions are unknown. The warning of a stroke or a heart attack rests on the family's report of what doctors said.

benefit: BMP-10 sedation index tracked sedation scores better than BIS
developer or vendor: Sichuan Xinyuan Bioelectronics Technology Co., Ltd. (四川新源生物电子科技有限公司)
AI tool: BMP-10 anesthesia depth monitor (麻醉深度监护仪), with its sedation depth index (NSI)
deployment context: Sichuan Xinyuan Bioelectronics Technology (registration trial with 140 patients at four clinical institutions); Four clinical institutions in China that the report does not name
use-case relevant outcome: agreed with sedation scores 90.62% of the time
what the sources leave unknown: The trial was the applicant's own, self-controlled and enrolled 140 patients at four institutions. The reference was a MOAA/S sedation score. The report says that the NSI agreed with that score more often than BIS did but gives no BIS figure. The trial compared agreement, not patient outcomes with and without the monitor.

benefit: NHS AI acceleration software lets MRI services do 14% more scans
AI tool: AI acceleration software for MRI (not named in the source)
deployment context: NHS England and NHS trusts; England, United Kingdom
what the sources leave unknown: The release gives no study or data for the 14% figure and names no software. New scanners added in the same period also raised capacity, so the software's share is not separated.

benefit: QP Prostate flags a tiny tumor that a biopsy confirms in Girona
